recon_sweep.name: Recon Sweep
recon_sweep.desc: Reveals an area for 20 seconds. Usable anywhere.

shell_barrage.name: Shell Barrage
shell_barrage.desc: Off-map artillery pounds an area. The target must be inside your coverage or within 15 of it.

field_repair.name: Field Repair
field_repair.desc: Repairs your units and buildings in an area. Own coverage only.

signal_surge.name: Signal Surge
signal_surge.desc: +50% radius on all your emitters for 30 seconds.

blackout.name: Blackout
blackout.desc: Removes enemy coverage in an area for 20 seconds. Usable anywhere you can see.

reinforcement_drop.name: Reinforcement Drop
reinforcement_drop.desc: Delivers a small infantry squad after a short delay. Own coverage only.
